spans.claim: The victim was Joseph Cochrane Robin, killed with an arrow
spans.anchor: Robin lying on his back with an arrow-shaft protruding from his breast
spans.span: I had been there about five minutes, I should say, when I chanced to look down on the archery range; and to my horrified amazement I saw Robin lying on his back with an arrow-shaft protruding from his breast.

spans.claim: The murder weapon was a hunting arrow taken from the panel
spans.anchor: missing hunting arrow from the panel
spans.span: Why, then, the missing hunting arrow from the panel?

spans.claim: Sperling confessed to the murder but was doubted
spans.anchor: Sperling’s eyes seemed to start from his head
spans.span: Sperling's eyes seemed to start from his head.

spans.claim: The typewritten note signed 'THE BISHOP' linked the crimes
spans.anchor: THE BISHOP
spans.span: And in the lower right-hand corner-the place of the signature-were the two words, in capitals: THE BISHOP.

spans.claim: The Riemann-Christoffel tensor formula was found on Sprigg’s body
spans.anchor: It contained part of a typewritten mathematical formula
spans.span: It contained part of a typewritten mathematical formula, with the lambda, the equals and the infinity sign marked in with pencil.

spans.claim: Mrs. Drukker screamed at the time of Robin’s death
spans.anchor: Mrs. Drukker denied having screamed

spans.claim: A black bishop chess piece was left at Mrs. Drukker’s door
spans.anchor: there lay a small chessman—ebony black

spans.claim: The missing .32 revolver was returned to the tool-chest
spans.anchor: there it lay—in plain sight—beside the other pistol
spans.span: And there it lay-in plain sight-beside the other pistol!

spans.claim: Pardee committed suicide in the archery-room
spans.anchor: His head and shoulders had fallen forward over the table
spans.span: His head and shoulders had fallen forward over the table; and his right arm hung at his side, the fingers still clutching an automatic pistol.

spans.claim: Professor Dillard was the murderer and committed suicide
spans.anchor: The “suicide” of Professor Dillard terminated the famous Bishop murder case
spans.span: The "suicide" of Professor Dillard terminated the famous Bishop murder case, and automatically cleared Pardee's reputation of all suspicion.

spans.claim: The child Madeleine Moffat was abducted and found locked in a closet
spans.anchor: she had been locked in the hall-closet on the top floor
spans.span: She had been locked in the hall-closet on the top floor of the Drukker house.

spans.claim: The typewriter and Drukker’s note-book were found in the attic
spans.anchor: In the suit-case was an old Corona typewriter
spans.span: In the suit-case was an old Corona typewriter.

spans.claim: The murderer tried to poison Arnesson with cyanide
spans.anchor: some one had been distilling hydrocyanic acid from potassium ferrocyanide
spans.span: When I was searching the attic this morning I discovered a little wall-closet in which some one had been distilling hydrocyanic acid from potassium ferrocyanide.

spans.claim: Vance switched the wine glasses to trap the murderer
spans.anchor: why, when you hopped up and pointed at that plate on the mantel, did you switch Arnesson’s and the old gent’s glasses
spans.span: Vance, but what I would like to know is: why, when you hopped up and pointed at that plate on the mantel, did you switch Arnesson's and the old gent's glasses?

spans.claim: The motive was jealousy and intellectual rivalry
spans.anchor: A colossal hate grew up in him for his foster son
spans.span: A colossal hate grew up in him for his foster son; Arnesson became in his eyes a kind of monster whom he himself, like Frankenstein, had created, and who was now rising to destroy him.

spans.claim: The murders were planned with nursery rhyme motifs
spans.anchor: The Mother-Goose motif was probably suggested to him
spans.span: The Mother-Goose motif was probably suggested to him when he heard Arnesson jestingly tell Robin to beware of an arrow from Sperling's bow.

spans.claim: The black bishop chess piece symbolized Pardee’s nemesis
spans.anchor: The black bishop is the symbol of his sorrow
spans.span: The black bishop is the symbol of his sorrow.

spans.claim: The final confrontation forced the murderer’s suicide
spans.anchor: He prepared for a swift and painless death when he distilled his cyanide
spans.span: He prepared for a swift and painless death when he distilled his cyanide.

spans.claim: The case was solved by psychological and logical analysis
spans.anchor: The Bishop murders were the acts of a mathematician whose values had become abstract and incommensurable
spans.span: The moment I saw it I sensed its sinister significance; and it substantiated my theory that the Bishop murders were the acts of a mathematician whose values had become abstract and incommensurable.

spans.claim: The false confession and misleading evidence were deliberate
spans.anchor: That spurious suicide, Sergeant, was the professor’s most fantastic joke
